dc_eval_autonomy.note: Extra doc (EU public summary of training content) covers data sources, crawling, opt-outs and illegal-content filtering only. Card pages 4, 11, 12 show the intro and capability charts (SWE-Marathon, Legal Agent Benchmark); training-summary pages 3-4 are data-source tables. SWE-Marathon (p11 figure) is a capability benchmark of long software tasks, not autonomy evaluated as a risk, so it stays 0.
